note: Failures the app has today that the commit adding the case does not fix. Each prints on every run and does not fail the run. A known failure that starts passing DOES fail the run, so a fix is never merged without its entry coming off this list. An entry matches a case id exactly through `case`, or by a regular expression through `match` when one finding shows up under several case ids.

failures.shows: Moving through a window or the sidebar with the Tab key draws nothing at all. An input, a select, a text area, a button and a sidebar item each report an outline of 0 pixels when the keyboard reaches them, in light mode and in dark, so a person using a keyboard cannot tell where they are.
failures.why: outline: "none" is set 14 times in src/App.js, on the shared input, select and text area and on every search box, and nothing replaces it. Commit three takes them out and draws a :focus-visible ring in both themes.
failures.where: src/App.js:158, src/App.js:159, src/App.js:167, and eleven more search boxes

failures.shows: Every page in light mode paints #0A1628 on the body element, behind the app. It is the colour the first frame is painted with, and it stays on the body for the life of the page.
failures.why: public/index.html sets body { background: %REACT_APP_THEME_COLOR% } and .env sets that to #0A1628, so the first frame is navy whatever the theme is. Commit three reads the stored choice and the computer's own setting before React loads and paints the matching background instead.
